name: PT Gozco Plantations Tbk
summary: PT Gozco Plantations Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, produces and distributes crude palm oil and palm kernel in Indonesia. The company engages in the planting of palms; and production of fresh fruit bunches. It is also involved in oil palm plantation; trading; and services related to agrobusiness and agro-industries. The company was formerly known as PT Surya Gemilang Sentosa and changed its name to PT Gozco Plantations Tbk in January 2007. PT Gozco Plantations Tbk was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Jakarta Selatan, Indonesia.
